releaseNotes: Recovers the offline package from Cache Storage when IndexedDB installation metadata is missing, after checking cached files by size and SHA-256.
Reuses verified cached files and downloads only missing or damaged files; valid cached files are not deleted because a verification record was lost.
Awaits the persistent-storage request and records its result; safely reopens IndexedDB connections after close or version change.
Adds diagnostics distinguishing IndexedDB metadata loss, Cache Storage loss, and loss of both.
Preserves the existing iOS Cache Storage namespace, IndexedDB database, student answers and progress, home-screen icon, and onboarding screens.
